title: Tenma Tsukasa — In Tearful Eyes, An Immortal Bird〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: In Tearful Eyes, An Immortal Bird（4★）
meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you all have your drinks, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then I'll do the honors, but before that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to say just how much I appreciate all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This audition... It was a tough ordeal, to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I felt so lost and stumbled multiple times along the way. I wasn't sure the current me would be up to the challenge, and I nearly gave up at certain points...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And yet, you were all willing to believe in me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all supported me when I decided to survive on nothing but water for three days and nights. I couldn't have done that by myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, we get how you feel.
So, let's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I greatly appreciate what you all did for me! No, I can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since the star I admire, Mr. Amami, also played Rio...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hold up, Tsukasa!
We've had our arms up this whole time, and mine's starting to get really tired...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We know that there's quite a lot that you wish to talk about. But for now, why don't you get our party started for us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Yes, I suppose.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's to me being selected to play Rio...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh...! I feel a wonderful fizz filling up my stomach!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Tsukasa, are you back to eating normally?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since I wanted to go into today's audition with a full stomach. So, this morning...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Your tummy just gave a huge growl!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have every right to feel hungry after putting on such a magnificent performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just asked for a drink so you could lead the cheer, but wouldn't it have been better to order some food too...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You may be right, but... That's odd. Until just now, I didn't really feel hungry at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's understandable that these things would slip your mind considering how focused you were on preparing for the audition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you're finally able to relax now that it's over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that may be it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my battle is just beginning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep practicing so that our show becomes an unforgettable one—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr. Silence, stomach!
Can't you see that I was on a roll?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For now, let's get some food.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Tsukasa, you gotta eat lots and lots today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excuse me! Can we have one of everything on this page?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, slow down!
Yes, I'm hungry, but I can't eat all that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah, Emu.
That's the page for Salisbury steaks. We should choose some stuff from the other pages.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. For now, why don't we each order something for ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? Don't you guys want to share some fries? Oh, fried chicken too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the page for sides. Yes, let's order some.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's all fried and greasy...
Can't we get something a little healthier?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, this place doesn't seem to serve anything of that sort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, quit covering up the salads!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Pasta sounds good, but so does a Salisbury steak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! Nene!
Let's get both and split them☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea.
Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know what I'm getting! Steak and curry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: To split with Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, for myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You must be famished.
Anyway, I'm also ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excuse me! We're ready to order!
